tasks.label: Check KasiCircle Backend Environment
args: set +x; set -a; if ! source .env.local 2>/dev/null; then printf "%s\n" "Create or fix backend/.env.local; private values are not logged." >&2; exit 1; fi; set +a; if [[ -z "$DB_USERNAME" || -z "$DB_PASSWORD" || -z "$JWT_SECRET" ]]; then printf "%s\n" "Set DB_USERNAME, DB_PASSWORD and JWT_SECRET in backend/.env.local; do not paste credentials into logs." >&2; exit 1; fi

tasks.label: Run KasiCircle Backend
args: set +x; set -a; if ! source .env.local 2>/dev/null; then printf "%s\n" "Create or fix backend/.env.local; private values are not logged." >&2; exit 1; fi; set +a; if [[ -z "$DB_USERNAME" || -z "$DB_PASSWORD" || -z "$JWT_SECRET" ]]; then printf "%s\n" "Set DB_USERNAME, DB_PASSWORD and JWT_SECRET in backend/.env.local; do not paste credentials into logs." >&2; exit 1; fi; exec mvn spring-boot:run
